data.one_liner: A Flutter widget providing shake animations with optional haptic and vibration feedback.
data.what_it_does: Adds a shake animation and optional vibration effects to any Flutter widget. Can be triggered on demand using a GlobalKey with built-in presets like light, medium, and heavy.
use_when: You need to indicate invalid form inputs or validation errors.
You want to draw user attention to specific UI components.
avoid_when: You need complex physics-based multi-directional motion engines.
Your application requires target platforms outside of Android and iOS.
strengths: Supports built-in presets and customizable offsets and vibrations.
weaknesses: Limited platform support (Android and iOS only).
Custom vibration patterns/intensities are Android only.
